highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews a native GTK4 GPU canvas alongside the Skia m156 engine update.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to use logical paint coordinates while retaining full-resolution backing pixels; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Target Tizen 10 or later
breaking.body: New SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages target net10.0-tizen10.0 on x64 and arm64 only; Tizen 8/9 and 32-bit targets are unsupported. Retarget consuming applications to Tizen 10 and a supported architecture; source builds require the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain. Tizen 10 device/package loading was not validated in the collected evidence.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m156. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100 without upgrading the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, optional tick-driven rendering, and GTK QueueRender invalidation. It uses GTK-provided GL contexts through libepoxy; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include that dispatcher.

Restores directory-backed default font discovery without adding fontconfig. Fonts are scanned from /usr/share/fonts/ unless the native build overrides the directory; an empty scan retains the existing empty-family fallback.
Releases the Skia surface before its Cairo-owned pixel storage and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling, keeping raster buffer lifetime and updates in ownership order.
Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later targets in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. .NET 8 stays on 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 stay on 3.1.56.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored directory-backed font discovery in Linux NoDependencies builds.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Introduced Skia m156 and the GTK4 GPU canvas, with physical-pixel raster painting by default. Restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, aligned .NET 11 WASM archives, and required Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64.

harfbuzz_summary: Aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archives with Emscripten 6.0.2 and raises Tizen native packages to Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64. Package revision 14.4.0.100 still uses native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews native GTK4 GPU rendering and Skia m156.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: GTK4 raster painting now defaults to physical pixels; opt into logical coordinates with IgnorePixelScaling. It also restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery, aligns .NET 11 WASM archives with Emscripten 6.0.2, and requires Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64.
